summary: Product-scoped record for Bitfinex's peer-to-peer Margin Funding market. Bitfinex's own 2023 retrospective states that the platform launched on 6 November 2012 as a P2P margin-lending platform; current first-party support continues to document funding providers supplying funds to margin traders and earning interest.
what_happened: Bitfinex says it launched on 6 November 2012 as a peer-to-peer margin-lending platform for Bitcoin and later expanded the funding market to additional assets. Current Margin Funding documentation describes a P2P order-book model in which funding providers choose amount, rate and term, matched traders pay interest, and Bitfinex deducts funding fees. Bitfinex launched Lending Pro in July 2020 as an automation tool for managing lending in the existing margin-funding market rather than as a separate yield platform. Current risk guidance states that Margin Funding is not risk-free and that, in an extreme market move where liquidations and collateral fail broadly, losses could ultimately be shared with funding providers. CYA therefore treats collateralisation and Bitfinex's risk controls as platform mechanisms, not as a principal guarantee.
uncertainty_notes: The 6 November 2012 date is supported by Bitfinex's own retrospective as the launch of Bitfinex as a P2P margin-lending platform; it is not asserted to be the first date on which the later 'Margin Funding' product label was used. Lending Pro's July 2020 launch is preserved as a separate automation milestone without inventing an exact July day.
notes: Bitfinex Borrow, Soft Staking, derivatives and other Bitfinex products are outside this product identity. Lending Pro is represented as an automation layer over Margin Funding, not as a separate canonical platform.

summary: Product-scoped record for Poloniex Earn / Polo Earn. Poloniex announced the rollout of Poloniex Earn on 28 December 2022, opened the first Polo Earn subscriptions on 4 January 2023, and continued launching flexible Earn products in 2026.
what_happened: Poloniex announced that it was rolling out Poloniex Earn on 28 December 2022 as a suite of cryptocurrency investment products, with the first Polo Earn subscriptions opening on 4 January 2023 at 00:00 UTC. Current product guidance describes flexible- and fixed-term products, daily interest, auto-subscription and redemption rules. Poloniex's introductory material characterises all Earn investment products as principal-protected, while launch and campaign notices also carry cryptocurrency high-market-risk warnings and disclaim liability for investment losses. CYA keeps the principal-protection statement attributed to Poloniex and does not convert it into a universal legal, custody or solvency guarantee. A March 2026 USAT Flexible launch confirms continuing operation.
uncertainty_notes: The 28 December 2022 date is the verified Poloniex Earn rollout date. The first Polo Earn subscriptions opened on 4 January 2023. Product-specific APY, quota, lock-up, redemption, supported assets and jurisdiction availability vary over time.
notes: Legacy Poloniex soft-staking programs and unrelated exchange products are outside this product identity unless separately reviewed.
